login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device

password.intro: Choose a new password for your account.
password.rules: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: This is the Phase 0 foundation. Hotel features arrive phase by phase.

placeholder.body: This screen is planned. It will be built in phase {{phase}} of the build plan.

dash.subtitle: Every hotel on HotelMS, at a glance.
dash.emptyBody: Create your first hotel. You'll get its Hotel Admin's sign-in details to share, and its free trial starts right away.

hotels.search: Search by name, email, phone or city

newHotel.subtitle: Creates the hotel, its main branch and its Hotel Admin account.
newHotel.name: Hotel name
newHotel.trialHint: Leave empty to use the default ({{days}} days). 0 = no trial.
newHotel.credentialsIntro: Give these sign-in details to the Hotel Admin. They must choose their own password the first time they sign in.
newHotel.emailSent: We also emailed these details to the Hotel Admin.
newHotel.emailNotSent: The email could not be sent – please share the details yourself.
newHotel.adminNote: They get a temporary password (shown to you and emailed) and choose their own at first sign-in.

hotel.suspendedBecause: Suspended by HotelMS: {{reason}}. The hotel can only view and export.
hotel.suspendedUnpaid: Suspended because the subscription is unpaid. The hotel can only view and export.
hotel.amountHint: Suggested from the plan. You can change it.
hotel.suspendHelp: The hotel can still sign in, view and export, but cannot save anything new until you activate it again.
hotel.resetHelp: Old passwords are stored scrambled and can't be shown. This creates a new temporary password. {{name}} will choose their own at the next sign-in, and is signed out everywhere now.

plans.subtitle: Prices are per room per month, with a minimum. Changes apply to new invoices.
plans.name: Name

settings.trialDaysHint: Used for every new hotel unless you set a different length when creating it.
settings.trialPlanHint: Which plan's features a hotel can try.
settings.graceHint: After this, the hotel becomes read-only until it pays.
settings.subtitle: Settings for the whole HotelMS platform.
settings.generalHelp: Your platform's name and how hotels can reach your support team.
settings.trialsHelp: How long new hotels can try HotelMS for free, and what happens when a subscription runs out.
settings.brandHelp: Shown in the sidebar, sign-in page, browser tab and buttons, for every hotel.
settings.loginMessageHint: Shown under "Sign in". Leave empty for the default.
settings.logoHelp: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 1 MB. Square logos look best.
settings.emailsHelp: How emails from HotelMS (welcome emails, new passwords) look to hotels.
settings.fromNameHint: The name hotels see in their inbox.
settings.footerHint: A short line added at the bottom of every email.
settings.demoPublic: Show "Try the demo" on the sign-in page
settings.demoPublicHint: Anyone can explore the demo hotel without an account. It is reset every night and never sends real emails.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Your name and phone, as your team sees them.
profile.name: Full name
profile.emailHint: You sign in with this email. Ask your Hotel Admin to change it.
profile.passwordBody: Change the password you use to sign in.

staff.subtitle: Everyone who can sign in to your hotel.
staff.name: Name
staff.empty: No staff yet. Add your first team member.
staff.ownRole: You can't change your own role. Ask another Hotel Admin.
staff.branchesHelp: They can only see and work in these branches. Hotel Admins always see every branch.
staff.createdBody: Share these sign-in details. They must choose their own password the first time they sign in.
staff.disableHelp: A disabled account is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until enabled again.

roles.subtitle: What each role is allowed to do. Staff get the permissions of their role.
roles.maxDiscountHint: The biggest discount this role can give on a bill.
roles.name: Role name
roles.lockedHelp: The Hotel Admin role always has every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.ownRoleHelp: This is your own role, so you can't change it. Ask another Hotel Admin.

activity.subtitle: Every change in your hotel: who did it and when.

permissionNames.dashboard.view_revenue: See money figures on the dashboard
permissionNames.fees.waive: Waive early check-in / late check-out fee
permissionNames.invoices.discount: Give discounts (up to the role's max)
permissionNames.cashier.own_shift: Open and close own cashier shift
permissionNames.roles.manage: Create and edit roles and permissions
permissionNames.settings.money: Currencies, exchange rates, taxes, payment methods

support.banner: You are signed in as {{name}} at {{hotel}} for support ({{by}}).
support.loginAsHelp: You'll see the hotel exactly as this user does. No password is needed. The visit, with your reason, is recorded in your log and in the hotel's own activity log.
support.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Help with setting up rooms

demo.banner: This is the demo hotel. Feel free to try anything – it starts fresh every night.
demo.tryTitle: Or try the demo hotel as:

settings.subtitle: How your hotel works: profile, money, rules and features.

profile.name: Hotel name
profile.footerHint: A short line at the bottom of every invoice, e.g. bank details or a thank-you.

branches.help: Each branch has its own rooms, prices and staff. Your plan sets how many branches you can have.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.codeHint: Used in booking numbers, e.g. BOL.

taxes.help: Taxes added to bills. Turn off any that don't apply to your hotel.
taxes.name: Name
taxes.inclusiveHint: Tick if your room prices are quoted with this tax inside.
taxes.example: Example: a room at {{price}} costs {{total}} with {{names}}.

payments.help: How guests can pay. Only active methods appear when taking a payment.
payments.name: Name

charges.help: Extras you add to a guest's bill, like laundry or minibar.
charges.name: Name
charges.priceHint: Leave empty to type the price each time.

cancellation.help: What a guest pays when they cancel or don't show up. The default is used for new bookings.
cancellation.name: Name
cancellation.freeUntil: Free until {{hours}} h before arrival, then {{fee}}
cancellation.appliesNoShow: Also charge this fee for no-shows
cancellation.isDefaultHint: Used for new bookings unless a manager picks another.

currencies.help: {{main}} is your main currency. Add others you accept (e.g. USD) and keep their rate up to date.
currencies.rateHelp: Rates are entered by hand and kept as history, so old bills keep the rate they used.

rules.help: Rules used when taking bookings and checking guests in and out.
rules.depositRequired: A deposit is needed to confirm a booking
rules.pendingHint: Bookings without a deposit are cancelled automatically after this time.
rules.cleaningHint: The room is blocked this long after an hourly guest leaves.

modules.help: Optional features. Your plan decides which ones you can use; turn them on or off any time.

about.housekeeping: Cleaning tasks, room status board and housekeepers' own task list.
about.cashier_close: Each receptionist opens and closes a cash shift; managers approve the count.
about.shifts: Shift templates and the weekly staff roster.
about.attendance: Clock in and out, with a PIN kiosk or manual entries.

attendance.help: How staff clock in and out. You can allow several ways.
attendance.selfHint: Staff clock in from their own account.
attendance.kiosk_pinHint: A tablet at the staff entrance; each person types their PIN.
attendance.manualHint: Managers fix or add times by hand.

subscription.help: Your HotelMS plan. Contact HotelMS to change it.

roomTypes.help: Each branch has its own room types and prices.
roomTypes.name: Name
roomTypes.optional: Leave empty if you don't offer it.
roomTypes.amenitiesHint: Separate with commas, e.g. Wi-Fi, TV, Balcony

rooms.help: Add rooms one by one, or many at once with the room generator.
rooms.noTypes: Add a room type for this branch first.
rooms.generatorHelp: E.g. floors 1–4 with 10 rooms each makes rooms 101–110, 201–210…
rooms.startNumber: First room number on each floor
rooms.typeByPosition: Room type by position on the floor
rooms.overLimit: Your plan allows {{max}} rooms ({{used}} used). Upgrade the plan to add more.

guestTypes.help: Groups of guests that can get their own price, e.g. Corporate, Government, NGO.
guestTypes.name: Name

rates.help: Change the room price on weekends, in seasons or for guest types. When several rules match a night, only the one with the highest priority is used.
rates.name: Name
rates.valueHint: Use a minus for a discount, e.g. -15
rates.previewHelp: See what a stay costs, night by night, with your rules.

setup.title: Hotel setup
setup.welcomeIntro: Let's get {{app}} ready for your hotel. Your progress is saved after every step, so you can stop and come back any time.

rules.title: Rules and team
rules.text: Money, taxes, booking rules and your staff.

account.title: Your account
account.help: Replace your temporary password with your own, and add a phone number to recover your account.

profile.title: Hotel profile
profile.help: Your hotel's name, logo and tax numbers. They are printed on invoices and receipts.

branches.title: Branches
branches.help: Your main branch is ready. Check its details and check-in/out times, and add more branches if you have them.

room_types.title: Room types
room_types.help: Add the kinds of rooms you sell, with their prices. Add at least one.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.help: Create your rooms. The room generator makes many at once, floor by floor.

payments.title: Currencies and payments
payments.help: ETB is your main currency. Add other currencies you accept, and turn payment methods on or off.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.help: VAT 15% is ready. Check the rates and whether your prices already include tax.

booking_rules.title: Booking rules
booking_rules.help: Deposits, how long unpaid bookings are held, walk-in payment, and early/late fees.

cancellation.title: Cancellation policy
cancellation.help: Choose what guests pay when they cancel or don't show up. Standard is a good start.

modules.title: Modules
modules.help: Turn on the extra tools included in your plan.

team.title: Invite your team
team.help: Add your staff. Each person gets an email with a temporary password.

review.title: Review and finish
review.help: Check each step. Skipped steps keep the sensible defaults, and everything can be changed later in Settings.

account.phoneHint: Used to help you if you forget your password.

state.defaults: Not done – defaults will be used

next.board: See all rooms on the room board

import.help: Download the template, fill in one row per room, then upload it. You can check and fix everything before anything is saved.

import.matchHelp_other: {{file}}: {{count}} rows. Tell us which column of your file holds each piece of information.
import.done: Imported {{rooms}} rooms and {{types}} new room types.
import.undoHint: Made a mistake? You can undo this import for 24 hours in Settings → Import from Excel.
